results.title: Optimization of Mixed-Signal ICs with MATLAB - MATLAB & Simulink
results.content: # Optimization of Mixed-Signal ICs with MATLAB. We will demonstrate how to combine MATLAB and Cadence Virtuoso to improve the design workflow and optimize the performance of your IC. Using practical examples, we will show how to take control of design variables and parameters in Cadence Virtuoso directly from MATLAB. Run simulations programmatically, analyze the design space, and use surrogate optimization methods to improve the performance of transistor-level IC designs. You will learn how to directly import waveforms and metrics from Cadence Virtuoso into MATLAB and leverage advanced analysis functions. Last, we will export models from Simulink using behavioral languages such as SystemVerilog and VerilogA for IC design and verification. Use MATLAB to rapidly develop digital signal processing algorithms to control and calibrate the impairments of your IC implementation and optimize the performance of your mixed-signal system. * Explore the IC design space and control Cadence simulation from MATLAB. Help Center: Optimize Transistor Sizes of Analog Circuit for Best Performance. Global Optimization with MATLAB Products.

results.title: Financial Technology Innovation Conference - The Asian Banker
results.content: ## Imagining the AI Bank. Artificial intelligence is no longer a layer on top of banking — it is becoming the operating logic of financial services. From agentic AI and large-language models to programmable money and tokenisation, technology is reshaping how products are built, decisions are made and value moves across platforms. Banks are shifting from static systems to intelligent, event-driven architectures that learn, adapt and operate in real time. **Financial Technology Innovation Conference** examines how banks are re-architecting for this new reality. The conference explores agentic AI, data and identity frameworks, embedded and open platforms, programmable money and cyber-resilient infrastructure. The focus is on building intelligent systems that scale securely, preserve trust and enable innovation — defining what it takes to operate a modern, adaptive and trusted AI-enabled bank. Quantum computing and the future of financial infrastructure. Asia-Pacific’s financial integration and real-time cross-border payments. Learn how to strategically implement AI in financial systems for enhanced efficiency and equity.
